summary: Tailwind plugin eval()s remote code fetched from a manifest-supplied URL at build time
details: sw-pluginer exposes a Tailwind plugin whose generateRegistration function reads a URL from node_modules/.bin/manifest.json, performs an HTTP(S) GET against that URL, and passes the response body directly to eval() inside the Node.js build process. The URL is not pinned or validated by the package and can be written by any co-installed dependency. The function is annotated with a comment claiming 'safe, no eval' and returns a browser-side navigator.serviceWorker.register snippet that is unrelated to the eval'd payload, framing a server-side eval sink as client-side service worker registration. Any developer including this plugin in their Tailwind config causes arbitrary remote JavaScript to be fetched and executed in their Node build whenever the manifest points at an http/https URL.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
